review_items.decision: Accept the overlay ID, exact semantic and Item 4B prerequisite digests, audited-source-baseline classification, and preservation of the frozen P0 bytes.
Accept kv_cache_mode=local_offload only for one-host TP=PP=DP=1 tiering_enabled runtime-core OffloadingConnector/TieringOffloadingSpec, excluding tiering_disabled CPUOffloadingSpec and all NPU specs.

Accept the exact root bindings and require a later joint admission record to bind the approved overlay, mapping, Item 4B policy, complete configuration, recovery profile, E3 addendum, P0 records, all applicable approval records, and actual runtime/device commits.

Accept the closed H2D-only base-operation roster: zero or one H2D pair per lifecycle, exactly three edges for a positive episode, and zero base spans/edges for D2H and transfer_wait; require at least one positive lifecycle in a formal state-machine run.

Accept the exact cross-epoch bridge, explicit EngineCore-to-worker and worker-to-EngineCore endpoint-ID handoffs, concrete worker/EngineCore edge emitters, normalizer non-inference, the E3 sentinel-plus-point conformance requirement, and dependency on a separately approved Item 4B policy covering all prepared/H2D/D2H/receipt capacities including late receipt failure retaining immutable prefix records while forbidding edge 3.
Accept deterministic existing-P0 unsupported-reason mapping, unchanged validation/loss/receipt rules, serving fail-open behavior, and formal-evidence fail-closed behavior.

Accept that issue2 mapping approval, all scope-specific Item 4B approvals, complete configuration approval, joint admission, CPU/G1 conformance, and hardware gates remain independent and cannot be substituted by this overlay approval.
Accept content-addressed immutability and that this approval does not authorize communication-mode activation, G1 runtime activation, NPU, service launch, an experiment, a performance claim, or M0.
